# theme-zoom

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-001 — The Theme button cycles Current, Dark, White and Cream](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-001.md) — When the reader presses the Theme button, the extension SHALL switch the preview theme mode in the order Current, Dark, White, Cream and back to Current, and show the active mode and the next one on the button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-013 — The host drops a theme-mode message with an unknown mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-013.md) — When a previewThemeModeChanged message carries a mode other than current, dark, white or cream, the extension SHALL drop it without changing the stored mode or answering.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-016 — Current mode follows the VS Code theme and redraws on change](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-016.md) — When the Current theme mode is shown or the active VS Code colour theme changes, the extension SHALL keep the preview in the colours of the VS Code theme: it colours the page, the toolbar and its pressed button with the VS Code theme variables for every host theme kind, high contrast included, tells every open preview that has a render the new theme kind, and draws a Markdown document again once no block editor is open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-018 — A high-contrast VS Code theme is followed like any other](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-018.md) — When the VS Code theme is a high-contrast theme and the Current mode is shown, the extension SHALL take the page colours from the host theme variables as for any other theme.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-024 — A theme switch starts no colour transition under reduced motion](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-024.md) — When the system prefers reduced motion and the reader presses the Theme button, the extension SHALL change the colours without marking the page as switching.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-025 — Dark, White and Cream paint the whole page the same on any VS Code theme](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-025.md) — When a forced theme mode (Dark, White or Cream) is shown, the extension SHALL paint the page, the floating toolbar and its pressed button, the sticky heading band and the note panels from the palette of that mode alone, so that the White mode paints a white page with the dark foreground text, light panels and a light colour scheme, and every forced mode looks the same on a dark and on a light VS Code theme.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-031 — Cream text meets a 4.5 to 1 contrast and keeps the body colour after an admonition](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-031.md) — When the Cream theme mode is shown, the extension SHALL give the foreground, description, link, six chart and error text colours a contrast of at least 4.5 to 1 on each of the editor, code block, block quote, hover widget, widget and input surfaces, and draw the paragraph after an admonition in the body text colour.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-034 — Page colours go through one token map of VS Code variables](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-034.md) — When the stylesheet is built, the extension SHALL declare each neutral --studio- token on the root and on body as the VS Code variable of the same name, so that the --vscode- prefix appears only inside that token map and every --studio- token the stylesheet or the Mermaid theme reads is in it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-038 — Zoom in and out change the zoom by 10 points within limits](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-038.md) — When the reader presses the Zoom in button below 200 % or the Zoom out button above 70 %, the extension SHALL change the zoom by 10 percentage points, set the zoom variable and the html attribute data-sphinx-preview-zoom to the new value, name the value of the next click in the button tooltips and disable the button at its limit.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-043 — Zoom scales the text and the column without a redraw](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-043.md) — When the zoom is set, the extension SHALL set the content font size to the base size multiplied by the zoom and the content column width to the maximum content width multiplied by the zoom, never wider than the pane, without drawing the page again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-055 — A zoom that cannot be saved still holds for the session](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-055.md) — When the workspace storage rejects the write of the view preferences, the extension SHALL keep the chosen zoom for the session.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-056 — The toolbar takes the forced mode colours](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-THEME-056.md) — When a forced theme mode is shown, the extension SHALL draw the floating toolbar and its pressed button with the colours of that mode, not with the VS Code ones.
